subject: Controls-view AXPopUpButton selection on a stock plug-in
question: Can a Controls-view popup parameter be set by selecting a named choice?

host.plugin: Compressor (mono), inserted on an audio track

reverify.expected: each opened popup menu exposes only its current choice (plus an untitled disabled entry), or duplicate identical titles
reverify.cost: needs a Compressor inserted and its editor in Controls view; ~1 min

method: Inserted Compressor through the slot's named custom action, switched the editor to Controls view via the measured 보기 -> 컨트롤 path, then opened each popup with AXShowMenu (the action the control advertises) and read every item attribute. Item counts were POLLED until they stopped changing rather than read once after a fixed sleep, so a short menu is not a settling artifact. No item was pressed: selecting an unnamed entry is the thing under refusal.

observations.note: reading label and current value works for every popup

conclusion: A Controls-view popup cannot be set by name. Three of the four opened menus expose only the current choice plus one untitled disabled item, while the visible UI offers several — Circuit Type shows one of Platinum Digital / Studio VCA / Classic VCA. Auto Gain is the decisive case: three enabled items whose titles are all '-12 dB', so the choices are indistinguishable and only the checkmark identifies the current one. Selecting by ordinal would be selecting by position, which this repository refuses as an identity everywhere else.
limits: State: and View Select: were censused but their menus were not opened.
No item was pressed, so this does not establish what pressing an untitled disabled entry does.
Compressor only. Other stock plug-ins may expose their popups differently.
This says nothing about whether Logic offers a non-AX route to the same parameters.
